datasets.title: Online Retail II transactions

expectations.note: customer_id determines country on 99.95% of identified rows (80 violations -- customers recorded under multiple countries).
Tens of thousands of exact duplicate line items (34,335 rows in the first run).
stock_code mixes plain numeric codes with letter-suffixed variants and non-product codes.
No finding separates cancellation invoices or negative quantities from ordinary lines. Counts verified on the prepared file.
22.8% of rows have no customer id; no missingness finding reports the rate. Count verified on the prepared file.

notes: Test-only for size: the prepared CSV is ~93 MB, beyond this repo's publishing path; prepare.py regenerates it locally. Bundling is a Git LFS decision. Expectations are set from the first local run (see docs/benchmarks).
